title: Ngetich's *marathon debut* is set
hook: The half marathon world champion will debut in Valencia on 6 Dec.

slides.label: What happened
slides.c: Race organisers announced on 12 Nov that the Kenyan will run her first marathon in Valencia on 6 Dec 2026.

slides.label: The numbers
slides.c: She also won the 2026 world road half marathon in 1:05:15. The fastest women's debut is Fotyen Tesfay's 2:10:51.

slides.label: Why it matters
slides.c: Tesfay, Joyciline Jepkosgei and Emily Sisson are also named. Fans will watch whether Ngetich beats the best debut ever.

caption:
NEWS: Agnes Ngetich to make her marathon debut in Valencia

Valencia organisers announced on 12 Nov 2026 that the world half marathon champion and 10K world record holder will debut over 26.2 miles on 6 Dec. The fastest women's marathon debut is currently Fotyen Tesfay's 2:10:51.
Source: Canadian Running Magazine, Reuters
